comments.value: Perhaps there should be a specialized portal where only friends of the person who dropped the portal can see it, that way you can avoid opportunistic raids and this would be equivalent to the previous layout, with more simplicity however.

comments.mergedPostDetails: Quite often, especially during "world-hopping", users join their friends and then ask other people to join them or tell them they're going to send them an invite, but the problem is, it's not comfortable. And I do understand that bringing tons of people through a portal to those who wanted to remain in a private instance may be an issue, so I think dropping portals to invite-only instances may not be as good as in other cases, but there's got to be a faster way to join people in public and possibly friends+ instances as a group with the use of portals.

To be able, to click on somebody, and instead of only an option to join them in the world, being able to drop a portal to let other people join as well (only for public, friends+ worlds though, so it won't be used to flood somebody's private world)

comments.value: Yes, been wanting this from the start. I find it crazy how it's still not a thing.

I don't know why this isn't now a thing with the new portal locking feature.
To elaborate on this request now: We should be able to drop portals to already-existing Friends or Friends+ worlds (that would be forced to be locked-only). The only people able to see the portal would be people under the rule set of the original instance creation.
If it was a friends only instance you and any friends of the instance owner would see the portal. If it's Friends+ then it would be visible to you, your friends, and any friends of people already in the instance.
So much easier than running around telling people, "Hey join on me (or X person) in a minute" and people trickling in.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

details: It would be nice if we could spawn a portal from the friends list, so we can have a way of getting a group to join on one friend instead of having to join and invite everybody separately.
title: Create portal from friends list
